kind: Preregistered held-out command schedule and initial-support test; frames were in training reference, so this is not held-out motion-data generalization.
full_behavior_acceptance_requires: Separately frozen gates, complete actual-state CSV, uninterrupted policy control, no resets/termination/exhaustion during GO, and video review. Schedule completion alone is not acceptance.
stop_response_policy: No user-specified response deadline. Score terminal stable-hold quality; report earliest sustained stable-stop response separately. Finite stage duration limits observation, not a claimed hardware response requirement.
